conditions: Chrome 152, Apple Metal-3 adapter, 1280x800 CSS pixels at DPR 2 (2560x1600), unchanged Rust demo sample counts and workloads, sequential cases; 3 seconds warmup, 3 seconds measurement.
limits: Steady-state audit of 16 runnable gallery entries, BoomBox and two initial MVP demos (19 cases); several gallery entries share a Rust implementation. Before/after paired measurements cover the first 17 cases.
Short local runs, not a large-scene stress test or an original Three.js parity benchmark.
GPU timestamps use a separate instrumented run; its 240 readback/resolve buffer creations per case are measurement overhead, not renderer allocations.
CPU/API runs do not enable GPU queries; timings are observations, not portable CI thresholds.
Shadow/effect/compute paths were additionally reviewed and covered by native regression tests, not by these gallery timing measurements.
